h:
这是我为 Z-Image 拼凑而成的工作流程。它使用 Z-Image 基础进行合成，使用 Z-Image Turbo 进行细节处理，然后使用 Z-Image Turbo 皮肤细节处理通道。我并不认为这个工作流程是最有效或经过深思熟虑的，但它给了我很好的结果，YMMV。

您可以在生成阶段和细化阶段使用 LORA。我将 ModelSamplingAuraFlow 设置为 7-9 以进行合成。在细节阶段根据需要使用降噪，但我通常将其设置在 0.28-0.34 之间。对于皮肤细节通道，我将其保留为 0.32，它给了我很好的结果。

如果您不喜欢 LORA Manager，您可以更换这些节点。另外，我使用子图来帮助组织工作流程，但请随意根据您的喜好解压它们！

o.en:
This is a workflow that I cobbled together for Z-Image. It uses Z-Image base for composition, Z-Image Turbo for detailing and then a Z-Image Turbo skin detailing pass. I don't claim this workflow is the most efficient or well thought out but it has given me good results, YMMV.

You can use LORAs in the generation stage and detailing stages. I set the ModelSamplingAuraFlow to 7-9 for composition. In the detailing stage use denoise as required but I usually have it between .28-.34. For the skin detailing pass I leave it at .32 and it gives me good results.

If you don't like LORA Manager you can swap out those nodes. Also, I use subgraphs to help organize the workflow but feel free to unpack those to your liking!
